app_context.name: KeluargaKita (OpenFamily ID Edition)
app_context.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY + SWISS UTILITY (Trust, Warmth, Harmony, Clarity)
app_context.description: A modern multi-family management platform inspired by OpenFamily. Built with clean, minimalist shadcn/ui SaaS aesthetics, high information density, generous spacing, precise role-based permissions, and intuitive family switching.

theme_and_colors.theme_mode: Light mode primary with Dark mode support via toggle

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit / System Sans

sidebar_structure.header: Brand Logo + Family Switcher Dropdown (Command Dialog inside Popover/Dropdown)
sidebar_structure.footer: User Profile Avatar + Role Badge + Dark/Light Theme Toggle + Exit/Logout

layout_and_navigation.mobile_responsive: Sheet component for Mobile Navigation Drawer triggered via Menu Hamburger button in Sticky Top Bar.

family_switcher.component: Dropdown Menu with embedded Command search or Select with Combobox
features: Current active family display with avatar/badge
Switch family in 1-click (updates app scope globally)
Actions: '+ Buat Keluarga Baru' dialog, '🔑 Gabung via Kode' dialog

roles_and_permissions.permission_matrix_table: Included in Settings > Permissions tab with toggles for budget access, journal visibility, task creation, and invite permissions.

invitation_and_join_flow.invite_dialog: Generates 8-character unique alphanumeric code (e.g. KEL-89F2A) with 1-click Copy Code, QR Code display, and email input option.
invitation_and_join_flow.join_dialog: Input field for join code with auto-formatting and immediate preview of target family name.
invitation_and_join_flow.join_requests_table: Data Table with Accept / Reject buttons and role assignment dropdown.

components: Balance, Monthly Income, Monthly Expense Summary Cards
Category Budget Progress Bars with warning indicators when >80%
Interactive Transactions Data Table with Search, Filter by Category/Member, Add Expense Dialog
Savings Goals with Progress Rings and Target Dates

features: Mood selection (😊 Senang, 😐 Biasa, 😔 Sedih, 🚀 Bersemangat, 😴 Lelah)
Calendar view grid with daily journal entries indicator

settings_tabs.ownership_transfer: Requires double confirmation modal with typing family name verification.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns, tabs, dialog triggers) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use shadcn/ui components: Sidebar, Navigation Menu, Button, Card, Avatar, Badge, Dialog, Alert Dialog, Dropdown Menu, Sheet, Select, Combobox, Command, Input, Textarea, Label, Form, Tabs, Table, Data Table, Calendar, Date Picker, Popover, Tooltip, Sonner, Progress, Separator, Skeleton, Scroll Area.
Do NOT use Material UI, Ant Design, Chakra, Bootstrap, or DaisyUI.
Ensure all monetary amounts use IDR currency format (e.g. 'Rp 12.500.000').
All interface text must be in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., Dasbor, Keuangan, Anggota, Undangan, Perencanaan, Pengaturan).
Implement Family Switcher context state so changing the active family instantly updates dashboard stats, budget, members list, journal, and tasks.
Ensure generous padding (p-4 to p-8) and cardless/subtle bordered container styling to maintain a premium SaaS look.
